subject: Recommendation to Award SOC 2/ISO Assurance Engagement to NorthStar Audit Co.
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recommendation to Award SOC 2/ISO Assurance Engagement to NorthStar Audit Co.

Team —

After consolidating panel scores and legal/finance input, I recommend we award the SOC 2/ISO assurance engagement (RFQ-2026-SOC2-01) to NorthStar Audit Co. Summary rationale: 

- Best fit for our hybrid deployment scope (hosted API + Private VPC + Dedicated). Their proposal explicitly covered private/on-prem evidence collection and testing windows.
- Highest technical understanding of inference runtimes and cloud-native telemetry among finalists (panel avg score 8.9/10).
- Most competitive fixed-fee retainer for Type II (6-month window) with limited hourly add-ons for out-of-scope items — projected FY27 spend ~USD 135k vs. BluePeak at ~175k.
- Strong references from two SaaS companies that run GPU-backed inference stacks.

Attachments: scoring_matrix_v3.xlsx (detailed panel scores), RFP_submissions_bundle.zip (vendor proposals), SOW_draft_NorthStar_v1.pdf (initial SOW).

Requested next steps:
1) Procurement (Markus) to confirm PO cadence and payment terms (Net30 vs Net45).
2) Legal (Evelyn) to review the draft SOW and highlight non-starters in commercial terms (indemnity cap, data handling, subprocessor clauses).
3) Security (Rishi) to confirm auditor independence and confirm the scoping list (service endpoints, data flows to be included).
4) If green across, I will notify NorthStar and request a final SOW and proposed audit start window (aiming for kickoff w/c 2027-02-01).

I realize awarding early locks in a vendor for next year's attestations — my view is NorthStar gives us the right balance of cost, demonstrated SOC2/ISO experience with model-serving platforms, and a pragmatic approach to evidence collection that aligns with our product SLAs.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of GRC Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recommendation to Award SOC 2/ISO Assurance Engagement to NorthStar Audit Co.

Thanks, Grace — good write-up and well-scored. A couple of procurement items for clarity before I issue the PO: 

- Payment terms: can we target Net45? NorthStar's quote assumes Net30 but they indicated some flexibility for a retainer model. If legal needs Net30 for contract language, call it out.
- Travel/onsite: their budget line includes up to two onsite days for fieldwork. Confirm whether we want to limit travel and prefer remote evidence collection where possible to keep costs down.
- Milestones: I need a proposed schedule we can put on the PO: kickoff, interim testing window, final report delivery.

If everyone signs off, I can create the PO next week and route to finance for approval.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recommendation to Award SOC 2/ISO Assurance Engagement to NorthStar Audit Co.

Thanks — I reviewed the SOW_draft_NorthStar_v1.pdf and have the following required redlines/conditions before Legal can approve execution: 

1) Data handling & retention: Add explicit language that any customer data accessed during testing will be treated as Confidential, retained only for the duration of the engagement, and returned/deleted within 30 days of report issuance.
2) Subprocessors: Require NorthStar to provide a subprocessor list and get our written consent for any third parties with access to production telemetry.
3) Indemnity & cap: We cannot accept an unlimited indemnity for third-party claims tied to service outages. Propose mutual indemnity with a cap equal to 12 months of fees.
4) Audit evidence storage: If they store evidence in their systems, we require encryption-at-rest and access logs forwarded to our security team.
5) Change of control: If NorthStar is acquired during the engagement, provide a right to terminate with 30 days' notice and refund for undelivered work.

Once Procurement confirms payment terms and Security confirms scope, I can prepare a redline to return to NorthStar.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recommendation to Award SOC 2/ISO Assurance Engagement to NorthStar Audit Co.

Quick security notes from my review of the panel notes and vendor proposals: 

- Independence: Confirmed via reference calls that NorthStar has not performed any advisory work for Redwood in the past 36 months and will not be performing any consulting during the engagement window. Need this in writing.
- Scope clarity: We should include the private VPC deployment, Dedicated GPU pools, and streaming endpoints that handle tokenized telemetry. I suggest a scoped list of 6 API endpoints + 3 admin consoles to be explicitly enumerated in the SOW to avoid ambiguity later.
- Evidence collection method: Prefer a mix of remote collection (log pulls, telemetry exports) + one remote interview per engineering team. Avoid repetitive intrusive testing during production windows.

If Legal adds the data handling language Evelyn suggested and Procurement locks Net45, I have no objections to proceeding.

Subject: Re: Recommendation to Award SOC 2/ISO Assurance Engagement to NorthStar Audit Co.

Hi Grace / team —

Thank you for the recommendation and for the thoughtful review notes. NorthStar is pleased to accept the opportunity to work with Redwood Inference. A few points from our side: 

- We can accommodate Net45 payment terms for clients with an approved PO; please confirm PO number when issued.
- We will provide a formal subprocessor list and confirm we have not provided advisory services to Redwood in the past 36 months—will put that statement in the SOW.
- Draft SOW (attached) includes a proposed audit timetable: kickoff (wk of 2027-02-07), testing window (2 weeks remote), and final report delivery by 2027-03-25. If that schedule works, we will allocate the engagement team and begin scoping calls in the week after PO.
- We accept the proposed indemnity ceiling of 12 months' fees and will remove any broad unilateral indemnity clauses; our legal team will accept mutual indemnity language with standard carve-outs.

Attached: SOW_draft_NorthStar_v1.pdf (updated with schedule), redlines_summary.pdf.

Looking forward to working together — happy to hop on a short call to finalize the PO terms.

Best,
Tim Hanley
VP, Audit Services
NorthStar Audit Co.
